limitations.quote: s1_d0, s4_d0110:   nstate = data ? s2_d01 : s1_d0;
limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but also reused the final zero of a match as the start of another sequence, whereas the original FSM returns to idle after a match on a valid one or an invalid cycle.
The exhaustive test used a sliding window over valid bits as its oracle, so it expected the extra overlapping matches instead of catching them as regressions.
